Migration's done. Twelve files were still on `db.query`, one per package repo/service/admin module. Each got its `sql` and `params` moved into a `db.execute({...})` call.

I left `cache.query` and `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` alone since those aren't part of this migration. `verify.js` confirms it: no stragglers, every module still works.
